entries.content: Lumaria is a bustling 1st-world metropolis with advanced steampunk technology. It relies heavily on industrialized steam technology to function. Johan was born and raised in Lumaria.

entries.name: The Halcyon
entries.content:
The Halcyon is a former scout-class military airship. It has since been retrofitted to be a cargo freighter, hauling cargo between Lumaria and other cities. Aksel and Johan both work as crew members aboard the airship.
Aksel works as a mechanic on the Halcyon.
Johan is the head of the engineering team on the Halcyon, and works closely with Aksel as his supervisor.
